summary: CORE-SUCCESS-DISPROOF: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The evidence does not identify what the pytest cases directly test or show that they establish the claimed correctness or conformance properties; passing the test suite is otherwise only a pipeline result. It also does not explain why the stated README condition would disprove the approach.

CORE-TRACE-REVIEW: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The disproof criterion (“a README headed '## Details' still passes --final”) has no named run, trace location, or requirement for evidence beyond its final outcome.
CORE-TRACE-DEBUGGING: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The evidence does not explicitly distinguish this procedure from anticipated failure modes.

CORE-SYSTEM-MODEL: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The trace review does not state a concrete observable that the examined run must show for the element “check.sh enforcement”; “the output shows what that line says” is insufficient. The plan also lacks applicable source-linked views, an explanation of material view omissions, concrete model freshness or drift checks, and a statement of how the model, view coverage, and verification evidence will be reconciled in the same change (or concrete reasons updates are unnecessary).
